component.name: KytyPS5-GTK
component.summary: Experimental PlayStation 5 emulator with a GTK launcher

description.p: KytyPS5-GTK is a Linux fork of the experimental KytyPS5 PlayStation 5 emulator. Its GTK launcher lists the games in your game folders, keeps their settings, and starts them in the emulator.
KytyPS5-GTK is not affiliated with or endorsed by Sony Interactive Entertainment. It includes no games and no system software: you need game files that you obtained legally.
